FAQ

Why do waterproofing leads go cold?Slow follow-up after the form or missed evening calls. Pair phone coverage with a clear next step on your site (book inspection, send a photo, or get a price range).
What is a sensible first stack?An answering plan that fits your call volume, plus Jobber or Housecall Pro for estimates and scheduling, and QuickBooks or Wave for books.
Is ServiceTitan worth it here?We list it for larger HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops (10+ techs) with a long onboarding. Most small waterproofing crews are better on Jobber or Housecall Pro first.
